title: GitHub_AsCode project context
description: Names the environment variables that hold every value the automations need, and the defaults that bound a run. It holds no value that is itself a secret, and no account name: the owner is an environment variable name too, because an account name is identifying data and this file is committed.

version.description: Version of this context file's shape, not of the product.

github.description: Every property here ends in Env and holds the NAME of an environment variable, except apiVersion, which is a public constant.

apiVersion.description: Sent as X-GitHub-Api-Version. Pinned, because the default is whatever GitHub has promoted most recently, and an API version that changes without a commit is drift with no diff.

pageSize.description: REST caps per_page at 100. A larger value is silently clamped by the API, so it is rejected here instead.

maximumPageCount.description: Upper bound on pages followed in one collection. Reaching it makes the plan blocked, never silently truncated.

minimumRateLimitRemaining.description: PHASE 3, read by nothing yet. The floor on x-ratelimit-remaining below which a run that is about to write aborts before starting. Declared now because the shape of the declaration is the design, and deliberately unimplemented: a write protection built before the writer is machinery nothing exercises. See docs/adr/0001-write-boundary.md.

minimumWriteIntervalMilliseconds.description: PHASE 3, read by nothing yet. The minimum gap between two writes, to stay under GitHub's secondary rate limits. Declared now, unimplemented until a writer exists.

tokenExpiryWarningDays.description: Days remaining on a fine-grained token below which plan emits a warning. Read by repo-inventory.

configuration.description: Repository-relative path of the active configuration. Excluded from version control: it names real repositories.

template.description: Repository-relative path of the versioned template. The active file is produced by RENAMING this one, not by copying its contents: the active name is what .gitignore excludes, and a copy invites a new name full of real values that Git happily tracks.

environmentVariableName.description: The NAME of an environment variable, never its value.
